review.notes: PASS at full resolution. Rich four-view explanatory plate. Central physics is correct: every (1,1) state contains exactly one carrier per dot; the S/T0 ket equations use antiparallel-spin superpositions; S(1,1) maps to S(0,2) with the left dot empty and two opposite-spin carriers in the right dot while T0(1,1) stays occupied and blocked; J and Delta E_Z drive the defined logical z and x axes; the J(epsilon) sweet spot is correctly ordered; physical boundary-spin exchange 2-3 is separated from capacitive coupling. No Josephson/inductor cross-contamination or unsupported performance claims. Minor issue accepted: an arrow is drawn inside the empty left dot of the S(0,2) readout cartoon to indicate tunneling, but no carrier marker is present and the charge label is unambiguous.
